title: Password reset flow
author: benchmark
note: Non-cryptographic RNG for a security token, and the token is logged.

changed_files.diff:
+import random
+import logging
+
+log = logging.getLogger("auth")
+
+def create_reset_token(user):
+    token = str(random.randint(100000, 999999))
+    user.reset_token = token
+    log.info(f"reset token for {user.email}: {token}")
+    return token
